name: Mumbai Chapter
description: The flagship chapter of TheDarkNet Community. Based in the financial capital of India, our Mumbai chapter runs monthly CTF nights, security auditing workshops, and hosts the annual HackByte competition.

name: Bangalore Chapter
description: India's tech capital hosts our most active chapter. The Bangalore team focuses on web application security, cloud security research, and has strong ties with the local startup ecosystem.

name: Delhi Chapter
description: The Delhi chapter specialises in OSINT, threat intelligence, and government/enterprise security. We host the annual OSINT Summit and collaborate with cybersecurity policy organisations.

name: Hyderabad Chapter
description: Home to our binary exploitation and reverse engineering enthusiasts. The Hyderabad chapter runs the toughest bootcamps in the community and publishes regular research on low-level vulnerabilities.

name: Chennai Chapter
description: The Chennai chapter focuses on network security, hardware hacking, and IoT security research. Known for the annual Network Security Hackathon and regular red team simulation exercises.

name: Pune Chapter
description: Pune's chapter bridges the gap between academia and industry. With close ties to local engineering colleges, we run mentorship programmes, research groups, and malware analysis workshops.
